⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The most amazing care for Bailey ❤️

Well, where do I start?

I have been bringing my Cockapoo, Bailey, to Clonsilla Village Vets for the past six years. Bailey is an extremely nervous dog and hates being away from my side, so finding someone I completely trust with him means absolutely everything to me.

Recently, I brought Bailey in because he had developed a cyst on his eye, and we were greeted by Daniel. From the moment we walked through the door, his care, kindness and genuine concern for Bailey were second to none. He explained everything so clearly and patiently, and for the first time in a long time, I left a vet appointment feeling completely reassured and confident that Bailey was in the best possible hands.

We then had to return for a second visit when Bailey became very poorly with a mouth infection and a high temperature. Once again, Daniel took the time to explain everything to me and made sure I understood exactly what was happening. I have never felt as reassured leaving a vet appointment as I did that day.

What really stood out to me was that Daniel even came into work on his day off to make sure Bailey received his medication. That level of dedication and genuine care is something I will never forget. ❤️

Today, 27th August 2026, Bailey came in to have his teeth removed. As a very nervous Mammy, I was naturally worried, but I knew without a doubt that he was with the best person I could have asked for. Daniel looked after Bailey with such kindness, patience and professionalism, and I cannot thank him enough for the care he has given him throughout all of this.

Bailey is now recovering very well at home, and I honestly cannot praise Daniel enough. He has gone above and beyond for Bailey, and it is very clear that he genuinely cares about the animals he looks after and the people who love them.

Thank you so much, Daniel, for looking after my boy and for giving me such peace of mind when I needed it most. Bailey and I are so grateful. ❤️

Clonsilla Village Vets are very lucky to have someone like you. 🐾❤️

I have been a client of this veterinary practice for over two years, but unfortunately my recent experiences have left me with no choice but to leave this review.

Last year, I discovered that I had been automatically locked into another 12-month healthcare plan without my knowledge or consent. When I questioned this, I was told that the plan could not be cancelled and that I would have to remain in it until the following year’s renewal date. Despite never agreeing to another year, I was forced to continue paying for a membership I had not consented to.

I have two dogs same breed, both of whom suffer from allergies and require Royal Canin Hypoallergenic dog food as part of their dietary requirements. One of my dogs still has an active healthcare plan, meaning I am still paying for and entitled to the benefits of that membership. However, I was told I could no longer receive the 20% discount because we had always purchased the food under my other dog’s account, which has since been cancelled. This made no sense to me, as both dogs live in the same household, eat exactly the same food, and I still have an active healthcare plan? I wasn’t asking for anything extra—I simply wanted to continue receiving the benefit that I am still paying for.

I spoke with the clinic manager, Elaine, in the hope that she could explain why this was the case. Unfortunately, I was never given an explanation that made sense to me. The only answer I repeatedly received was that they “just can’t” apply the discount, without any clear reasoning or policy being explained. This left me feeling frustrated and as though the company’s policies were being applied at the discretion of individual staff members rather than consistently.

I have also found the experience at the Clonsilla reception disappointing. On several occasions, I felt ignored when I walked in and found the reception staff to be inattentive, which did not make me feel valued as a long-standing customer. In contrast, I would like to acknowledge the receptionist in the Castleknock clinic, who has always been friendly, welcoming and genuinely helpful. Her professionalism stood out and is appreciated.

After more than two years as a loyal customer, I expected much better communication, transparency and customer care. Instead, I was left feeling undervalued and disappointed by the way my concerns were handled.

As a result, I have now transferred both of my dogs to Anicare Veterinary Clinic in Blanchardstown Village. The transfer process has been straightforward, and after hearing consistently positive feedback about the practice, I wish I had made the move much sooner.

Based on my experience, I do not recommend this practice. I would encourage anyone considering registering their pets here to carefully review the terms of the healthcare plan and ensure they fully understand how it operates before signing up. I only wish I had done the same sooner.

Absolutely awful experience. I had an appointment today (16/05 at 10:45) for my dog Sully and the entire place seemed chaotic from the moment I arrived. The waiting room was full of people, clearly showing they were overbooked and struggling to manage appointments properly. The clinic itself also did not feel particularly clean or welcoming.

What made the experience even worse was the receptionist’s attitude. I arrived on time and waited while she continued chatting away instead of acknowledging customers standing there. After several minutes, I finally asked about my appointment and was immediately met with a rude and dismissive response. She told me that I had “just crossed the door” and that my appointment had been missed, so the vet would refuse to vaccinate my dog.

Completely unacceptable behaviour. There was no apology, no attempt to help, and no professionalism whatsoever. If the clinic is running behind or overbooked, that is not the customer’s fault. The receptionist’s attitude alone was enough to make sure I will never return.

I had already heard negative feedback about this place before going but decided to give it a chance because it was close to home. Huge mistake. Thankfully I never signed up for their health plan for my two Frenchies because after this experience I would not trust this clinic with anything.

Luckily, I managed to get an appointment today at the clinic I normally use, and I’m confident they will take proper professional care of my two Frenchies, unlike what I experienced here.

Avoid this place if you expect basic respect, professionalism, or competent customer service.

Edit1: Your response only makes the situation look worse because it contains claims that are simply untrue. I did not arrive 20+ minutes late, and no same-day alternative appointment was ever offered to me. I was left standing at reception waiting to be acknowledged while the receptionist continued chatting, and when I finally asked about my appointment, I was met with dismissive and unprofessional behaviour. Ironically, I still managed to get the same vaccination done later that day at my usual clinic in a far more professional environment for €65 instead of the €120 quoted by your clinic.

Village Vets have unfortunately bought over my local vets who are brilliant. My vet made an appointment with Just Cats in Clonsilla to have teeth extractions as she was aware of how stressed my cat gets at the vets. She reassured me that JC know how to deal with this. I spoke to JC and made an appointment for 7.45am. The evening before the appointment I get a text from VVets to bring him to VVets Clonsila for 8.15am. I arrive at 7.30 and there is no one in JC, it’s closed. Staff started to go into VVets which is right next door so I went in to enquire and they said you can leave him in here. No one called me back so at 2pm I call them. The person giving me the update on my cat started to chastise me for not drugging him before the appointment as he was very stressed. I stopped her and told her that my vet had specifically made the appointment with JC as they deal with stressed cats. She quickly back peddled and said ok come and get him at 4.30. When I got there the same person said that they gave him Gabapentin after the operation as he can’t take metacalm. She said you will enjoy him on this drug as it makes them very affectionate and hungry. I don’t know how anyone could think you could enjoy your cat in the state he was in, unless you were a sadist. The cat couldn’t use his back legs was crying the whole time and obviously distressed. On the second day I brought him back to my vet who said that Gabapentin hasn’t been proven to kill pain, it just works on stress. She gave me tramalieve which is an actual pain killer. So they sent the poor animal home from a serious operation with no pain relief and changed the venue of the appointment when it was requested that the cat specifically suffers from stress and it should be taken into JC. My vets at the Animal Welfare Clinic are fantastic and I’m sorry they are now associated with Village Vets who obviously don’t have the animals best interest at heart. Shameful how they treated my cat, well Village Vets, you are also free to contact me and apologise in person

Their health insurance it’s a scam!
The receptionists and veterinarians are kind, gentle, and attentive, but I needed to have a stool sample taken for my dog ​​and was surprised by a bill of 44 euros. When I questioned whether it wasn't covered under the plan since it was a basic exam, the manager said no! I also questioned why they didn't mention a cost when the exam was requested; they didn't explain anything. I received a call from the manager and questioned again that it was a simple and basic exam. They didn't explain what was covered under the plan or that I would be charged for the stool sample. She replied that I could have read the contract that was sent to me by email and that I could have canceled within 14 days, and that if I wanted to cancel at that time I would have to pay a fee. In short, I don't recommend their plan. Most dog health plans in Ireland cover a large part of consultations and exams. I was frustrated.
